digest.component_or_area: criteria eval CLI preflight / gate-aware criterion admission
propositions: The criteria eval CLI preflight rejects activated project code-review ids as unknown because it only checks the plan-review registry.
The preflight should look ids up in both the plan-review and code-review effective registries and admit an id present in exactly one gate.
An id active in exactly one gate is dispatched to the gate-aware calibrate_criterion path.
An id active in both gates must be rejected with exit 1 and an ambiguous message naming plan_review and code_review.
An id present in neither registry keeps the existing unknown error with exit 1.
The subparser help text must include the concrete code-review example project.foo.
